# Notifuse

> Notifuse is an open-source email platform — newsletters, campaigns and transactional email — that you run on your own infrastructure, under your control. Self-hosting is free, with no per-email, per-contact or per-seat fee. Six capabilities need a paid licence key; everything else does not. A hosted cloud version exists for teams that prefer not to run servers.

Key facts:

- Source code: public on GitHub (notifuse/notifuse), BSL 1.1, each release becomes AGPL-3.0 after four years.
- Free tier: run in production and self-host at no cost, including 3 workspaces, each in its own isolated PostgreSQL database.
- Six capabilities need a licence key: more than three workspaces, granular permissions, Amazon SES tenant isolation, template translations, single sign-on (OpenID Connect), audit logs.
- Self-hosted licences (per year, per deployment): Studio $290 (5 workspaces), Agency $890 (15 workspaces), Enterprise $1,990 (15 workspaces), Custom quoted per deployment for larger or regulated setups.
- Licence keys are verified offline against a signature in the binary: no phone-home, no account, nothing about an installation is sent to Notifuse.
- Paid licences include private email support in English and French, Monday to Friday. Free-tier support is on GitHub Issues.
- Notifuse claims no certification (no HDS, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or HIPAA attestation). Organisations that need certified hosting deploy Notifuse on infrastructure they qualify themselves.
- Live demo, no signup: https://demo.notifuse.com/console/signin?email=demo@notifuse.com

## Product and pricing

- [Homepage](https://www.notifuse.com/): What Notifuse is, who it is for, and how deployment works.
- [Self-hosted licences](https://www.notifuse.com/pricing/self-hosted): Free tier, the six licensed capabilities, licence tiers and prices, Custom licences, support terms.
- [Licence keys (docs)](https://docs.notifuse.com/self-hosting/licence.md): Which capabilities need a key, what happens without one, how to install a key.
- [Cloud pricing](https://www.notifuse.com/pricing/cloud): Hosted plans from $19/month, for teams that do not want to run servers.
- [Self-hosted installation (docs)](https://docs.notifuse.com/self-hosting/installation.md): How to deploy Notifuse on your own servers.

## Segments

- [Multi-entity networks](https://www.notifuse.com/networks): One platform for a whole franchise or multi-entity network — headquarters controls the brand, each entity sends from its own isolated workspace.
- [Public sector](https://www.notifuse.com/public-sector): Email that stays on public organisations' own infrastructure, with auditable code.
- [Regulated industries](https://www.notifuse.com/regulated-industries): Deploying Notifuse inside a compliance perimeter you already qualify, including health-data hosting (HDS) responsibilities.
- [Compare alternatives](https://www.notifuse.com/compare): Notifuse compared with Mailchimp, Brevo, Resend, Loops, Klaviyo, Customer.io, MailerLite, Listmonk and Mautic.

## Trust and security

- [Security and compliance](https://www.notifuse.com/security): SSO, granular permissions, scoped API keys, audit logs, workspace isolation, offline licence verification, and the vulnerability disclosure process.
- [Vulnerability disclosure policy](https://github.com/notifuse/notifuse/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Private reports acknowledged within three business days, first assessment within ten business days.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/notifuse/notifuse): Source code, issues and community support.
- [Releases](https://github.com/notifuse/notifuse/releases): Version history and release dates.

## Documentation

- [Documentation home](https://docs.notifuse.com/): Guides for workspaces, contacts, templates, campaigns, automations and the transactional API.
- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://docs.notifuse.com/llms.txt): Full machine-readable index of the documentation, including the API reference (every docs page also exists as Markdown by replacing the extension with .md).
- [Workspaces (docs)](https://docs.notifuse.com/features/workspaces.md): The isolation unit — each workspace has its own contacts, templates, domain and database.
- [Transactional API (docs)](https://docs.notifuse.com/features/transactional-api.md): Sending event-driven email from an application.
- [Single sign-on (docs)](https://docs.notifuse.com/self-hosting/sso.md): OpenID Connect sign-in with an existing identity provider.
